title: Fan-out worker return
description: The structured payload each fan-out agent returns on completion. Integration reads this, not free prose. A worker that fails or times out is recorded with status=failed and a placeholder row; integration continues (a partial run is resumable, not a crash).

agent.description: The worker's name (matches the fan-out ledger row).

task.description: The task/ticket id or one-line scope the worker was dispatched for.

status.description: done: work committed and self-tested; failed: could not complete (record why in summary); blocked: a precondition is missing (name it in blocker).

worktree.description: The worktree path this agent ran in.

changed_files.description: Every file the agent changed, relative to the worktree root. The parent spot-checks this against git.

test_result.description: The command run and its outcome (e.g. "pytest tests/cache: 14 passed"). Never empty — a claim without a run is not done.

summary.description: Short summary of root cause and changes. Bounded prose; the machine-readable fields above are the integration source of truth.

blocker.description: Present when status=blocked: the missing precondition and what unblocks it.
